cabins.name: Flagship First Suites
cabins.description: Safran (formerly Zodiac) Flagship Suites designed to function as a work desk, a lounger and a 6'-10" long fully-flat bed

cabins.name: Flagship Business seats
cabins.description: Fifty-two Safran Cirrus II seats configured 1-2-1 and arranged into two cabins. Each seat has direct access to the aisle and featured a retractable bi-folding table, and secure stowage for small personal items

cabins.name: Premium Economy seats
cabins.description: Twenty-eight Collins Aerospace MiQ seats arranged in a 2-4-2 configuration, featuring lumbar support, footrest, and an individual goose-neck reading light

cabins.name: Economy seats
cabins.description: Safran (formerly Weber) 5751 slimline seats configured 3-4-3, each features a retractable bi-folding table
